#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> bal(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        bal[i] = (i == 0 ? 0 : bal[i - 1]) + (a[i] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }

    vector<int> diffs;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (bal[i] == 0) {
            diffs.push_back(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    while (!diffs.empty()) {
        int minIdx = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j < (int)diffs.size(); ++j) {
            if (diffs[j] < diffs[minIdx]) {
                minIdx = j;
            }
        }
        int d = diffs[minIdx];
        diffs.erase(diffs.begin() + minIdx);
        if (b >= d) {
            b -= d;
            ++ans;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
